video_summary.overall_goal: Configure and generate a jigsaw puzzle: increase puzzle width and height sliders then tap Generate Puzzle to load the puzzle board.
video_summary.description: Recording opens on the Google Play Store app detail page for 'Jigsaw' by Josef Ott, then the user opens the app to its puzzle-configuration screen, drags the width slider from 2 to 4 and the height slider from 2 to 3, taps 'Generate Puzzle', and the app transitions to the generated puzzle board showing scattered unsolved pieces.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Google Play Store listing for 'Jigsaw' by Josef Ott, with Uninstall/Open buttons, changelog, and description visible.
steps.system_response: Toggle/press animation begins on Open button area
steps.visual_feedback: Open button shows a highlighted/pressed blue pill state
steps.intent_task: Launch the Jigsaw app from Play Store

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Jigsaw Puzzle configuration screen with Puzzle Picture preview, Puzzle Size width/height selectors (both showing 2), 'Without Rotations' toggle row, and 'Generate Puzzle' button.
steps.system_response: App finished launching into configuration screen
steps.navigation_change: Play Store -> Jigsaw app configuration screen
steps.visual_feedback: Configuration screen fully rendered with size values at 2 / 2

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Puzzle Size width value incrementing from 2 up to 4 as user drags/taps near the width row.
steps.visual_feedback: Width numeric value updates on right side of Puzzle Size row

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Puzzle Size height value incrementing from 2 to 3 while width remains at 4.
Puzzle Size now shows a total/derived value of 12 (4x3) with width 4 and height 3 rows visible.
steps.system_response: Finger moves toward and presses Generate Puzzle button
steps.visual_feedback: Generate Puzzle row highlighted under finger press
steps.intent_task: Confirm size configuration and generate the puzzle

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Generated puzzle board with scattered, unassembled puzzle pieces spread across the screen in three loose rows/clusters; no pieces connected into the final image yet.
steps.system_response: Configuration screen replaced by generated puzzle board showing unsolved scattered pieces
steps.visual_feedback: Multiple jigsaw piece shapes rendered loose on screen, video ends before solving begins

overall_flow: Open Jigsaw app from Play Store listing
Land on puzzle configuration screen with default 2x2 size
Puzzle board renders with scattered unsolved pieces (video ends, no solving observed)
human_readable_step_summary: User taps Open on the Play Store listing to launch Jigsaw.
App loads into the puzzle configuration screen with size set to 2x2.
User increases the puzzle width from 2 to 4.
User increases the puzzle height from 2 to 3.
User taps Generate Puzzle to confirm the 4x3 (12-piece) configuration.
App transitions to the puzzle board, showing the pieces scattered and unsolved; recording ends here.
